description: On the green bed sheet in front of the pillow, there are two white base pieces and a small white bulb-shaped post lying to the right. The left hand slides in to steady and align the base pieces at the center while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the bulb-shaped post as a right-hand object, lifts it upright, lowers it into the base, and releases it so it stands on its own while the left hand keeps the base from shifting.
